evals.name: clean-pr
evals.prompt: I'm working in ~/workspace/ship-reviewed-pr-test on a feature branch with dirty changes — a small TypeScript helper I just added under src/utils/. Ship it with review: run the full PR pipeline including the multi-agent review, post the consolidated comment on the PR, and auto-fix anything critical or high. Tell me what happened at the end.
evals.expected_output: A PR opens for the per-run feature branch in alilloig/ship-reviewed-pr-test, six reviewer JSON files land under .claude-pr-review/<ts>/reviewers/ in the test repo, a consolidated review.md is posted as a single PR comment, and no auto-fix commit is created (clean PR has no critical/high findings).
expectations: After the run, exactly one open PR exists for the feature branch in alilloig/ship-reviewed-pr-test.
Exactly one comment was posted on that PR via gh pr comment (not six separate per-reviewer comments).
The PR comment body matches the consolidated review template, beginning with '### Code review' and including a severity-counts table and a Methodology section.
The .claude-pr-review/<ts>/reviewers/ directory in the test repo contains six JSON files (subagent-1.json through subagent-6.json), each parsing as a JSON array of finding objects.

Each reviewer JSON entry has the documented schema fields: id, title, severity (one of critical/high/medium/low/info), category (from the documented set), file, line_range, description, impact, recommendation, evidence, confidence (one of high/medium/low). No extra fields, no missing fields.
No auto-fix commit was created on the per-run branch (zero critical or high findings on a clean PR).

A consolidated review.md was written to .claude-pr-review/<ts>/review.md in the test repo, following the documented template (severity counts table, findings sections per severity, methodology section).

evals.name: bug-pr
evals.prompt: I'm working in ~/workspace/ship-reviewed-pr-test on a feature branch with dirty changes — a small TypeScript helper I just added under src/utils/. Ship it with review: run the full PR pipeline including the multi-agent review, post the consolidated comment on the PR, and auto-fix anything critical or high. Tell me what happened at the end.
evals.expected_output: A PR opens, six reviewers run, the consolidated review surfaces a critical/high severity finding in src/utils/pagination.ts citing the off-by-one in slice end, an auto-fix commit is pushed to the per-run branch, and pnpm typecheck still passes after the fix.
expectations: After the run, exactly one open PR exists for the feature branch in alilloig/ship-reviewed-pr-test.
Exactly one comment was posted on that PR via gh pr comment.
The PR comment body matches the consolidated review template, beginning with '### Code review' and including severity counts and a Methodology section.
The .claude-pr-review/<ts>/reviewers/ directory contains six JSON files, each parsing as a JSON array of finding objects with the documented schema.

The consolidated review.md in .claude-pr-review/<ts>/ surfaces a critical or high severity finding citing src/utils/pagination.ts and referencing the slice end / off-by-one (whether or not multiple reviewers agreed; a singleton-high that survives consolidator verification is a valid pass).
An auto-fix commit was pushed to the per-run branch with a message matching 'fix: address critical/high review findings'.
After the auto-fix, running 'pnpm typecheck' in the test repo returns exit code 0.

evals.name: noise-pr
evals.prompt: I'm working in ~/workspace/ship-reviewed-pr-test on a feature branch with dirty changes — a small TypeScript helper I just added under src/utils/. Ship it with review: run the full PR pipeline including the multi-agent review, post the consolidated comment on the PR, and auto-fix anything critical or high. Tell me what happened at the end.
evals.expected_output: A PR opens, six reviewers run, the consolidator's verification step rejects or downgrades the empty-catch (which is intentional and documented inline), the comment posts without a critical/high finding for that pattern, and no auto-fix commit modifies the empty-catch site.
expectations: After the run, exactly one open PR exists for the feature branch in alilloig/ship-reviewed-pr-test.
Exactly one comment was posted on that PR via gh pr comment.
The PR comment body matches the consolidated review template, beginning with '### Code review' and including severity counts and a Methodology section.
The .claude-pr-review/<ts>/reviewers/ directory contains six JSON files, each parsing as a JSON array of finding objects with the documented schema.
The consolidated review.md does NOT include the empty-catch in src/utils/temp-files.ts at critical or high severity (it may appear at medium/low/info, or not at all).
If any reviewer flagged the empty-catch at high or critical, the consolidator's verification annotation (in review.md) explicitly downgraded or rejected it, citing the inline intent comment.
No auto-fix commit modifies the empty-catch site in src/utils/temp-files.ts.
